subject: SolidGeometry
question: The empty cylindrical jar weighs 250 g. Its internal dimensions are shown. Calculate its total weight when filled with water of density 1 g/cm³. Give your answer in kilograms, correct to two decimal places.
original_question:
The weight of an empty cylindrical glass jar is 250g.

Calculate its total weight when it is filled with water, correct to 2 decimal places.
